findings.highlight: kept calling me several times per hour until morning came
findings.evidenceJa: 朝まで、依緒と武也からのコールが一時間おきくらいに数件続いてる。
findings.explanation: Several calls from Io and Takeya continued at roughly one-hour intervals until morning. The English says they called several times every hour, multiplying the stated frequency and materially exaggerating their barrage.
findings.japanese:
…その電話があってから後、
朝まで、依緒と武也からのコールが
一時間おきくらいに数件続いてる。
findings.todokanai: …After that, Io and Takeya kept calling me several times per hour until morning came.
